receipts.method: The real-sway screen-reader tests in WSL on 3586a0d's files, with the real Orca 51.1 and at-spi2-core 2.62.1 (/var/tmp/plans-venv, PyQt6 6.11): 7 passed, 13 deselected (-rA names each pass). Chatmon finds the running Orca and moves the ask box to a window of its own, which sway floats, centres and focuses; a screen reader finds its field, buttons and conversation; only as a window is the box ever an active window to a screen reader; what changes in it reaches AT-SPI listeners; and with Orca, the box as a window is announced and echoes typing while drawn on the overlay it is neither announced nor echoed.
